description: Probabilistic assessment of tropical cyclone recovery burden across US Atlantic and Gulf Coast counties is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Simona Meiler, Stanford University (stanford.edu). Dataset for the following paper: Meiler, S., Blagojević, N., Lochhead, M., Gori, A. and Baker, J. W. (2026). Probabilistic assessment of tropical cyclone recovery burden across US Atlantic and Gulf Coast counties. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: tropical cyclone, recovery burden, post-disaster recovery, residential buildings. Published 2026-08-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
